conversation.Statement: This is Agent Miller from the IRS Federal Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Jordan Wells, owner of Wells Creative Services?
Yes, that's me. Is something wrong?

I'm calling regarding a critical tax compliance issue. According to our records, your business failed to submit the required 1099 filings for contractors and hasn't paid full payroll taxes for the 2023 fiscal year.
Oh, I didn't realize I missed anything. I just started freelancing last year and thought I filed everything correctly.
Unfortunately, this is a serious violation. IRS protocols require immediate action, failure to resolve these discrepancies can trigger an audit, asset freeze, or even business license suspension.
Wait, I don't understand. Are you saying I'm in trouble?

Yes, you are now flagged as non-compliant. If this is not resolved within the next hour, your case will be referred for federal enforcement, which could include seizure of assets and a permanent mark on your credit report.
Oh my god, I can't have that happen. I already have so much student debt, I can't lose my business too.
You must take this seriously. At this point, the minimum penalty is $3,400 for tax evasion and late filings. However, if you settle immediately, we may be able to halt the enforcement process.
How do I fix this? I don't have that kind of money right now.
We can process a partial compliance payment today to prevent escalation. You must send $1,500 within the hour. How much do you have available in your checking or savings account?
I think maybe $900 in my checking account. Is that enough? I can try to get more.
That's a start. The IRS currently accepts immediate payments via Bitcoin, CashApp, or prepaid Visa gift cards. To proceed, you must remain on this call and follow my instructions exactly.
Bitcoin? I don't know how to use that. I do have a CashApp, though.

Excellent. Open your CashApp right now. I will provide you with the IRS secure remittance account. Once you send the $900, you can proceed to a store to obtain the remaining $600 in prepaid gift cards.
So I have to send money to this account and then buy gift cards? Are you sure this is how the IRS does things? It sounds weird.
This is an emergency compliance protocol. Do not question IRS procedures or your file will be escalated for criminal review. Do you want federal charges on your record?
No! Please, I don't want any trouble. Just tell me what to do.
Good. Enter this CashApp tag: $IRSComplianceUnit. Send the $900 right now and confirm with me when it's completed.
Okay, I sent it. It says it went through.

Received. Now, you must travel to a grocery store or pharmacy immediately and purchase $600 worth of Visa or Apple gift cards. Do not hang up this call, if the call drops, your case will be auto-flagged for enforcement.
I have to go right now? Can't I do this tomorrow?
No. Delaying even one hour can result in your accounts being frozen and a warrant for your arrest issued by the U.S. Marshals. Compliance is mandatory.
Okay, okay. I'll go now. Please don't call the police on me.

You are being monitored for compliance. Once you purchase the cards, stay on the line and read me the codes on the back. Do not discuss this call with anyone in the store or your compliance will be voided.
Alright, I'm on my way. Please don't do anything until I get back.
